question_vi: Spring Kafka integration: cách produce và consume message?
question_en: Spring Kafka integration: how do you produce and consume messages?
answer_html_vi:
Spring Kafka — KafkaTemplate để produce, @KafkaListener để consume.

Thêm dependency spring-kafka, config qua spring.kafka.* (bootstrap-servers, consumer group-id, JSON serializer/deserializer).

java
// Producer
@Service
class OrderEventPublisher {
  private final KafkaTemplate<String, OrderEvent> kafkaTemplate;

  public void publish(Order order) {
    kafkaTemplate.send("order-events", order.getId().toString(),
        new OrderEvent(order.getId(), "ORDER_CREATED"))
      .whenComplete((result, ex) -> { if (ex != null) log.error("Send failed", ex); });
  }
}

// Consumer
@KafkaListener(topics = "order-events", groupId = "inventory-service")
public void handle(OrderEvent event) {
  inventoryService.reserve(event.getOrderId());
}

Key của message (order.getId()) quyết định partition → message cùng order luôn cùng partition, giữ thứ tự.

Error handling: @RetryableTopic — retry tự động với backoff, đẩy vào Dead Letter Topic sau max retries.
answer_html_en:
Spring Kafka — KafkaTemplate for producing, @KafkaListener for consuming.

Add the spring-kafka dependency, configure via spring.kafka.* (bootstrap-servers, consumer group-id, JSON serializer/deserializer).

java
// Producer
@Service
class OrderEventPublisher {
  private final KafkaTemplate<String, OrderEvent> kafkaTemplate;

  public void publish(Order order) {
    kafkaTemplate.send("order-events", order.getId().toString(),
        new OrderEvent(order.getId(), "ORDER_CREATED"))
      .whenComplete((result, ex) -> { if (ex != null) log.error("Send failed", ex); });
  }
}

// Consumer
@KafkaListener(topics = "order-events", groupId = "inventory-service")
public void handle(OrderEvent event) {
  inventoryService.reserve(event.getOrderId());
}

The message key (order.getId()) determines the partition → messages for one order stay on one partition, preserving order.

Error handling: @RetryableTopic — automatic retries with backoff, Dead Letter Topic after max retries.
